conditions.product_formula: all original frames ordered symmetric S2

allowances.qualification: binary64 numerical pilot; no rounding enclosure

original_input.local_cli_path: Provide --input pointing to the same fixed bytes; cache outside old evidence is permitted

lineage.history_policy: Old CDF8/XDF8/XDF10 results remain comparison context only; no arrays/PF/ground/native/shots/cost from those targets are evaluated or substituted for XDF9.

numerical_definitions.basis: ascending Qiskit little-endian interleaved-spin sector_indices(4,2,2); existing OF contexts converted using bit_reverse_indices(8) and prefix.context().perm
numerical_definitions.sector_validity: Exact G=kron(G_spatial,I2) and kappa=kron(kappa_spatial,I2) are required. Each complete one-body/square factor preserves Nalpha,Nbeta. No intermediate circuit gate projection.
numerical_definitions.representation: 10 complete factors: existing SectorCAR.one square vs independent general-K I/Z/ZZ expansion; both permuted to H4 Qiskit order. Raw/K sums also compared to existing saved_xdf sector matvec target; max-entry<=1e-10, rtol0, finite mandatory.
numerical_definitions.K_conversion: Only diagonalize each fixed 4x4 saved G_spatial with existing diag_hermitian(assume_hermitian=True); J_l=2 lambda_l eta_l eta_l^T; original outer frame order unchanged. These 9 inner diagonalizations are included in K_model; no new DF decomposition or fit.
numerical_definitions.ground: Reuse H4 MolecularBackend._ground on the XDF9 sector sum; save all eigenpairs and own ground; residual<=1e-10, normalization error<=1e-12, finite, sector36 schema. No XDF10/CDF8 state reuse.
numerical_definitions.physical_correspondence: Same pinned physical input/sector and saved prefix9 DF norm+binary64_operation_scale_guard8_v1 reserve. No physical-minus-XDF norm or physical ground calculation.
numerical_definitions.alias: Reuse H4 window [-10,10] Ha. Require ground in window and max(abs(window))*0.1+pi/6 < pi. No H6 energy-dependent alias substitution.
numerical_definitions.PF: W_s is existing ordered_schedule over base+9 frames at h=1/(10s); evaluate ||W_s^(s*2^m)-V exp(-i*0.1*2^m E) V†||_2 with existing PF_rounds/numpy.linalg.norm(...,2), s=1,4; m=0..12. The shared XDF9 eigenpair is reused; repeated squaring after initial matrix_power(W_s,s).
numerical_definitions.PF_gate: Each computed nonnegative finite PF error <= sin(beta_total-beta_stat)=sin(pi/12); no added post-hoc tolerance or guard. Equality passes; absent evidence remains null. This is the existing numerical pilot rule, not a rounding-enclosed norm.
numerical_definitions.deterministic_RTE: No stochastic tail; RTE corrected discrepancy0 and attenuation1 structurally, not an estimate of unknown synthesis/law error.
numerical_definitions.unknowns: Synthesis, strict enclosure, CA achievement, shots, total cost, physical ground overlap remain null/unqualified.
numerical_definitions.H_XDF9: c I + sum(kappa_pq a†_p a_q) + sum_{l=0..8} lambda_l (sum(G_l,pq a†_p a_q))^2; retain original-g kappa and nuclear c once

call_definitions.saved_input_load: 1 whitelist original packet decode + 3 saved DF JSON records; no CDF/XDF10 numerical arrays/results or saved energies/states.
call_definitions.saved_DF_gate: 1 saved prefix9 PASS/source/consumed STOP/allowance policy gate; copy norm+guard without recomputing it.
call_definitions.sector_context: 1 composite existing PhysicalSector/matvec context + SectorCAR(4), sector36; no new CAR implementation.
call_definitions.input_identity: 1 composite schema/finite/exact spin lift/Hermiticity/bit+sector+CAR basis and permutation/kappa/scalar/order check; original-g correction checked once.
call_definitions.xdf_prefix_model: 1 existing saved lambda/G prefix9 DFHamiltonian and python df_linear_operator; no new outer decomposition.
call_definitions.xdf_matvec: 36 actual existing matvecs, one per sector basis column, individually journaled and permuted to H4 basis.
call_definitions.raw_factor: 10 complete-factor evaluations: base kappa+c and 9 lambda_l A_l^2, using existing sparse CAR; no physical DF-error norm.
call_definitions.K_model: 1 composite existing 9 fixed-G inner diagonalizations + 2lambda eta eta^T conversion + general-K number adapter. No fitter/native Gaussian synthesis.
call_definitions.representation_gate: 10 max-entry/Frobenius comparisons of raw factors vs independent I/Z/ZZ expansion; original-index/frame order retained.
call_definitions.sector_sum_gate: 1 composite raw sum vs saved-matvec XDF9 + K sum vs same target; no physical Hamiltonian.
call_definitions.ground_eigenpair: 1 existing H4 np.linalg.eigh+ground/spectrum export for own XDF9 sector.
call_definitions.ground_alias: 1 residual/normalization/sector/H4 alias gate. Alias outside registered window is UNRESOLVED, blocks PF.
call_definitions.sector_kernel_reference: 2 existing ordered S2 preparations, one per s. Each includes its 19 factor expm calls; reuse the single saved eigenpair.
call_definitions.PF_round_assessment: 26 operator 2-norm evaluations; 13 per s; reuse repeated squared powers and exact eigenpairs, save errors/metadata/status.
call_definitions.candidate_summary: 2 all13-round classification records; no shots/resource ranking.

execution_order: Separate explicit chat permission for this fixed published SOURCE/contract/input/scope; permission-proof artifacts not required
Passive bytes/source/environment check and fresh run01; inspect actual resources
Whitelist input+DF records; saved DF PASS; sector contexts; identity gate
Existing XDF9 matvec target; raw10; K model; factor10 and sum correctness gates
Own XDF9 ground/spectrum/residual/sector/registered H4 alias; unresolved alias ends with no PF
Independent s1 and s4 kernels and 26 rounds, then summaries; NOT_MET does not stop other registered cells
Persist SOURCE/input identity/contract/calls/resources/partial evidence/STOP; commit/push/remote verify; mandatory STOP

STOP.correctness: First SOURCE/input/schema/nonfinite/basis/Hermiticity/representation/ground residual or normalization/PF calculation failure: stop new dependent calls, drain started jobs, preserve partial journal/evidence. No fallback.
STOP.unresolved: Alias outside registered H4 window: UNRESOLVED_GROUND_ALIAS, no PF. Missing PF evidence: UNRESOLVED; no zero filling.
STOP.NOT_MET: Normal candidate outcome INFEASIBLE_REGISTERED_PHASE_ROOM; keep evaluating other registered cells/candidate. Means registered sufficient condition not met, not physical impossibility.
STOP.candidate_PASS: POTENTIALLY_FEASIBLE only if saved DF budget, all representation and ground/alias gates, and all13 PF conditions pass. Eligible to propose native evaluation; not permission, final CA or resource superiority.
STOP.completion: Mandatory STOP irrespective of outcome; stage2/3 require separate future contracts/conditions and explicit chat permission.
STOP.retry_resume: 0; existing output is never restarted, overwritten, resumed or retried

performance: Reuse existing resource_plan for two independent s jobs, sector36; preserve immutable input. Process-local BLAS1 coordination when both jobs run; no artificial CPU/RAM/worker/wall cap. No shared settings/cache/venv or other-user changes. No full256/512 matrix or full-space SVD in this stage.
qualification: Engineering numerical pilot only; stored DF guard is unchanged, PF/ground/representation tolerances follow H4. No strict floating-point enclosure, CA, synthesis, shots or resource ranking.
permission_policy: Current preparation is technical/synthetic only. Molecular execution requires separate explicit chat permission; no approval records/text storage/IDs/certificates/receipts/new grants.
scope_rationale: Recommended, not adopted: saved prefix9 DF eligibility is established but PF/own-ground eligibility and resource optimum are untested. This first95-unit stage excludes native/synthesis/shots/CA/cost.
future_conditions: CDF8 may be reused only if original input,target,frame/time/PF,precision Gaussian,P0,shared/fences,phase/failure/horizon and serial metric identities remain fixed. New XDF9 native/full512 profiles/shots/cost need separate scoped preparation and permission after this STOP. No automatic continuation.
